mechanism_narrative: The sharp recovery in WORKPLACES from -53.3 to -18.9 implies more commuting and midday foot traffic; that should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks because shopping trips co-move with return-to-office routines.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES continues to improve but RETAIL_REC stays below its last-4-week mean for the next 28 days, this commuting-to-retail mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A continuing decline in TRANSIT suppresses casual shopping access; when TRANSIT falls further below its current level, RETAIL_REC should weaken within one to two weeks because fewer trips reach retail districts by public transport.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -45 and stays there for at least 2 consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT remains deeply negative across the snapshot, with values from -32.1 to -46.9
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains at or below the trigger yet RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week average within 2 weeks, the access constraint claim fails.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT move up together, the combined increase in commuting and city-center circulation raises retail visits more than either series alone; this interaction should push RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rebounded sharply in t-0w while TRANSIT also improved from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC does not outperform its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days, the interaction claim fails.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL time signals substitution toward home-based activity and away from discretionary shopping; if RESIDENTIAL remains above its current level, RETAIL_REC should remain lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while RETAIL_REC rises above the last-4-week mean over the following month, the home-substitution mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS relative to its recent trough indicates better weather or leisure demand, which spills into nearby shopping trips and lifts RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 8 points from its recent 2-week low
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -3.7 to -13.0 across the snapshot, indicating volatility around a low base
failure_condition: If PARKS crosses the rebound threshold but RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to its last-4-week mean within 14 days, the spillover claim fails.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES recover while GROCERY_PHARM is stable or rising, it signals broader normalization rather than emergency substitution; under that regime, discretionary retail should strengthen over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is positive throughout the snapshot while WORKPLACES improves sharply at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES rises but GROCERY_PHARM falls materially and RETAIL_REC still does not rise over the next 28 days, the normalization pathway fails.

mechanism_narrative: A four-week lagged pullback in GROCERY_PHARM after an early spike reflects stock-up behavior fading; as routine shopping shifts back to discretionary trips, RETAIL_REC should increase over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM drops by at least 10 points from the prior week after being positive
failure_condition: If a sharp GROCERY_PHARM drop is followed by flat or falling RETAIL_REC within 7 to 14 days, the stock-up-to-discretionary shift is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight-restriction regime, a partial rebound in TRANSIT without a matching rebound in WORKPLACES mainly reflects non-work trips and does not sustain retail demand; RETAIL_REC should therefore remain weak over the next four weeks unless both series rise together.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -46.1 to -38.9 while WORKPLACES improved from -48.6 to -18.9
failure_condition: If TRANSIT improves without WORKPLACES confirming and RETAIL_REC still rises above its last-4-week mean, the restriction-bound claim fails.
